$description: The colour pairs the widget set puts on screen, which every theme of every mood board must make legible. text: 4.5:1 (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3, EN 301 549 9.1.4.3). ui: 3:1 for what identifies a control or its state, focus rings included (SC 1.4.11, 9.1.4.11). The ratio is WCAG's, from the tokens' sRGB components.

pairs.use: body text, labels, key labels, menu items
secondary text, hints, quiet keys, disabled labels
text on the accent: primary buttons, the equals key
error and success messages, danger buttons
the focus ring, drawn outside the control on the surface around it
the border that shows where an input or a secondary button is
a filled control: primary button, checked checkbox
